test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

Anne said to Mary, “I have received a job offer from a company.”

options.text: Anne told Mary that I had received a job offer from a company.
Anne told Mary that I have received a job offer from a company.
Anne told Mary that she had received a job offer from a company.
Anne told Mary that she has received a job offer from a company.

solution:
The indirect speech of the given sentence is__** Anne told Mary that she had received a job offer from a company.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
 

 
 
Anne said to Mary

 
 
 
I have received a job offer from a company.

 
 
 

__Reporting clause__ __Reported speech__

__
 
• When the reporting speech is in present perfect tense then all the speech Changes to past perfect tense.

 
 
• have-----had
 
 
 
• Said to of the reporting verb changed into told.
 
• Replace comma (,) and inverted commas (" ") with the conjunction 'that'.
 
• I(first person) of the Reported Speech changed according to the subject of the Reporting clause(**Sh****e**).

 

​So, the final sentence is: Anne told Mary that she had received a job offer from a company.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__What is Direct & Indirect Speech?__

 
• 
 Direct speech – reporting the message of the speaker in the exact words as spoken by him.

 
 
• Direct speech example: Maya said, "I am busy now".
 
 
 
• 
 Indirect speech: reporting the message of the speaker in our own words 

 
 
• Indirect speech example: Maya said that she was busy then.
